J1.evidence: Claim is false: English does not translate 51:44; it renders this entry faithfully: مُتَعَلِّقٌ بِقَوْلِهِ = attached to His words, صِنْفَيْنِ = two kinds, full list of pairs, بِحَذْفِ إِحْدَى التَّاءَيْنِ فِي الْأَصْلِ = one of the two tāʾs omitted, فَتَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّ خَالِقَ الْأَزْوَاجِ فَرْدٌ فَتَعْبُدُونَهُ = know the Creator of pairs is One and worship Him.

J2.evidence: The current English translates this entry's text, not 51:44: 'attached (mutaʿalliq) to His words' = مُتَعَلِّقٌ بِقَوْلِهِ, 'two kinds' = صِنْفَيْنِ, the full list male/female ... light/darkness, 'one of the two tāʾs ... omitted' = بِحَذْفِ إِحْدَى التَّاءَيْنِ, 'the Creator of the pairs is One, and so worship Him' = أَنَّ خَالِقَ الْأَزْوَاجِ فَرْدٌ فَتَعْبُدُونَهُ. Nothing from فَعَتَوْا/الصَّاعِقَةُ appears.
